review_scope: Checked the fixed-versus-rotating partner manipulation, four-agent private-type assignment, target/support graph invariants and fixed formal budget.
Checked all four source-level primary endpoint differences, fixed-checkpoint AUC and same-private-type message agreement.
Checked all eight ordered cross-type protocols, multi-partner pair metric, FW/WF recombination and 199-code relabeling references.
Checked independent raw statistics, bounded endpoint replay, formal input/source hash gate and figure visual QA.
Checked every absolute local link in the final report.

findings.interpretation: The endpoint target score is higher under partner rotation in all four initialization sources; this supports a bounded partner-reuse effect, not a claim of human-like language.
Independent copies with the same private type converge to much more similar messages under rotation; agreement is evaluated on identical frozen visual states.
Two-partner simultaneous correctness remains far below single-resource correctness, so the experiment does not establish stable multi-partner compositional structure.
Truth-conditioned fragment recombination exceeds the full-code relabeling reference, but the operation is offline and cannot establish autonomous composition.

limitations: Four population members reuse two frozen private encoders; this is controlled private variation rather than natural demographic variation.
Rotation is a fixed four-agent schedule without birth, death, migration, cultural transmission or generation turnover.
The task is a symbolic resource-location protocol, not a reconstruction of complete human ecology.
The bounded audit replays all endpoint sender worlds and receiver code tables plus selected fixture traces, but not every gradient or Adam transition.
The four sources are the independent units; panels, directions, masks and photos are nested repeats.
The finite 199-code reference is descriptive and has no interpretation as a four-source significance test.
next_step: Increase task pressure one mechanism at a time: bind both partners to the same-round payoff, add delayed third-party relay, and only then introduce new agents or generation replacement. Preserve fixed/rotating and equal-information controls.

figure_visual_qa.method: PIL raster dimension/finite/nonwhite checks plus direct visual inspection with view_image
